summary: IDS feed s081_single is degraded: 11.3% of frames (256/2266) exceed the IDS 1518-byte MTU (up to 8058 bytes) and are dropped by its NIC, creating a significant detection blind spot.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding jumbo frames up to 8058 bytes to a 1 Gbps IDS port limited to 1518 bytes without MTU handling. 256 of 2266 frames (11.3%) exceed the tool's maximum, exceeding the 1% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS network card silently drops all oversize frames, so ~11.3% of traffic is never inspected. IDS requiring full payload and both directions will miss signatures, file extraction, and session reassembly for those flows.

recommended_fix.why: IDS needs_full_payload=true so slicing would break detection. Enable jumbo MTU (~9000) on the IDS interface and broker egress port, or configure the broker to handle MTU/fragmentation, to prevent NIC drops while preserving full payload for inspection.
